market_summary: Strong USD bid across the board during London/NY Overlap. EURUSD and GBPUSD display clean, high-RVOL value area breakdowns below their respective VAL levels and downward-sloping VWAPs with heavily negative CVD pressure, presenting textbook momentum short setups. Meanwhile, BTCUSD completed a climactic high-volume liquidation flush leaving a long lower wick at Session Lows, warranting patience against chasing an overextended lower ATR band.

signals.rationale: 1) VP: Price is trading below VAL (1.10793) and far below POC (1.10928), confirming value breakdown. 2) CVD: CVD is -1,944 (NEUTRAL) but with an accelerating negative slope of -4,109.92, showing increasing aggressive selling pressure. 3) SESSION: LONDON_NY_OVERLAP provides optimal liquidity and breakout follow-through. 4) Trend: Firmly bearish, trading below descending VWAP (1.10863) and EMA50 (1.10888). 5) ATR: ATR is expanding (0.00064) with price pressing against the lower ATR band (1.10753). 6) RVOL: Confirmed with a high-volume spike (RVOL 2.506, yellow bar). 7) S/R: Successfully broke below Prev Low (1.10824) and heading toward S/R at 1.10710 and Session Low (1.10662). GEX is null. Strong bearish momentum continuation.
